I have done this with many different sites. Download URLSnooper. Then you launch it prior to starting the stream. When the stream is going you can find the streaming url which is often coming from a different site and looks like www.somesite.com/video/somefile.flv. You can then copy and paste that URL into a download manager, browser etc and download the file. Technically you are using the SAME URL as the stream and you are buffering the entire file on your hard drive instead of a few minutes at a time.

I am not advocating pirating or breaking any TOS etc.

If you have any troubles then google urlsnooper movie download and you'll find some guides.
